data.name: Bahubali
data.gender_notes: Bahubali is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bahubali means 'the one with great strength'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bahu', which means 'great' or 'large', and 'bala', which means 'strength'. Bahubali is a name of reverence and respect, often associated with power and courage. The name Bahubali carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bahubali usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bahubali belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahubali total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bahubali is particularly famous from the epic literary work "Bahubali-The Rise of the Warrior" by K.V. Satyanarayana and Anand Neelakantan, and the multi-part film series "Baahubali" directed by S.S. Rajamouli. These works have popularized the name and the concept of Bahubali as a legendary figure of immense power and courage, becoming a source of inspiration and pride for the Indian audience. The story of Bahubali has been passed down through generations, and the name has deep cultural significance in Indian society.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, Bahubali is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing the strength and courage that resides within each one of us. The name represents the inner power that drives us towards achieving our goals, overcoming challenges, and fulfilling our spiritual and personal dreams. Bahubali is a reminder of the importance of inner strength and resilience, and inspires us to strive towards our full potential. The name resonates with the Hindu philosophy of 'Shakti', or inner power, and encourages us to tap into our own inner reserves of strength and determination.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bahubali translates to 'the one with powerful arms'. This name symbolizes strength, courage, and the power to protect and serve. It is a reminder of the divine warrior within us, ready to face challenges and overcome obstacles.

historical_references.reference: Bahubali is a name that appears in several Hindu epics and mythological texts, specifically the Mahabharata and the Puranas. It is said to represent the epitome of strength and power.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Bahubali is found in the Jain text, the Kalpa Sutra, where he is described as a Tirthankara (Jain spiritual leader) and the 24th son of King Bharata.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Bahubali' is derived from Hindu mythology, specifically from the Mahabharata epic. In modern context, the name has gained significant popularity across various platforms. In cinema, the 2015 Indian epic film 'Bahubali: The Beginning' and its 2017 sequel 'Bahubali 2: The Conclusion' have set new benchmarks for Indian cinema with their grandeur, action sequences, and storytelling. These films have been watched by millions worldwide. On television, a Hindi language animated series, 'Bahubali: The Lost Legends', has been released, providing a deeper exploration of the Bahubali universe and its characters. In the world of books, several novels and graphic novels based on the Bahubali story have been published, offering fans a chance to delve deeper into the world of this iconic character.

name_in_real_life.story: Krishna Bahubali, a teacher in Delhi, India, shares that their name Bahubali meaning "Strong, Powerful" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
